function.name: check_service_area
function.description: Check whether Summit Air services a ZIP code (homes in Brooklyn, Queens and Manhattan; Bronx and Staten Island addresses get an office coverage check). Only for a quick 'do you serve my area?' question; it never replaces lookup_customer or triage_issue, which still run (triage_issue does this check too).

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the service address, e.g. 11372.

property_type.description: Home (residential) or business (commercial). Defaults to residential.
